text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Good work, everyone. You've all been 
working quite hard lately, I see!

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
...It seems the upcoming 'Representative 
Exchange Match' has become the talk of the 
town as well.

text_block_list.name: Mei Satake
text_block_list.text:
Please continue to etch your challenges 
into their hearts.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems she's successfully gained solid 
support from the public. Let's keep 
working hard together with <chrname>!
